text:
For making homemade pizza as described, you will need the following utensils and equipment:

1. A large mixing bowl for combining the dough ingredients.
2. A clean surface or countertop for kneading the dough.
3. A rolling pin to roll out the dough.
4. A pizza stone for baking.
5. An oven, preheated to the appropriate temperature.
6. A pizza peel or a baking sheet (if transferring the pizza to the stone) to move the pizza in and out of the oven.
7. A knife or pizza cutter for slicing the finished pizza.

The color of a common crow is black.
